words.enDefinition: A document summarizing someone's education, experience, and skills for employers

examples.en: My tutor in London offered to read my CV before the campus careers fair.
examples.zh: 在伦敦的校园招聘会前，导师主动提出帮我看一下「求职简历」。

examples.en: The careers adviser asked me to bring my CV to our appointment.
examples.zh: 职业顾问让我在预约见面时带上「求职简历」。

words.enDefinition: A detailed record of someone's education, research, teaching, and academic achievements

examples.en: I added a conference talk to my academic CV before meeting my supervisor.
examples.zh: 见导师前，我把一次会议报告加进了「学术履历」。

examples.en: The lab asked for an academic CV with a list of recent publications.
examples.zh: 实验室要求提交一份列有近期发表成果的「学术履历」。

words.enDefinition: A document presenting relevant education and work experience on one page

examples.en: The adviser helped me fit my summer work into a one-page resume.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我把暑期工作经历写进了「一页式简历」。

examples.en: I brought a one-page resume to each conversation at the careers fair.
examples.zh: 招聘会上，每次和人交谈时我都带了一份「一页式简历」。

words.enDefinition: A sample document with a reusable layout for summarizing experience

examples.en: I downloaded a resume template from the careers center and replaced the example text.
examples.zh: 我从就业中心下载了「简历模板」，换掉了其中的示例文字。

examples.en: The resume template had space for two projects below the education section.
examples.zh: 这份「简历模板」在教育背景栏下方留出了两个项目的位置。

words.enDefinition: A comprehensive record used to create shorter versions for specific jobs

examples.en: I keep a master resume with details from every project I have worked on.
examples.zh: 我保留了一份「简历总稿」，里面有我参与过的每个项目的详情。

examples.en: After the placement ended, I added my new duties to the master resume.
examples.zh: 实习结束后，我把新增的工作职责加入了「简历总稿」。

words.enDefinition: A document emphasizing experience relevant to a specific job or employer

examples.en: My tailored resume puts the tutoring experience first because the job involves teaching.
examples.zh: 这份工作的内容涉及教学，所以我的「岗位定制简历」把辅导经历放在最前面。

examples.en: The tailored resume for the lab role highlights my work with survey data.
examples.zh: 这份「岗位定制简历」突出介绍了我处理调查数据的经历，以应聘实验室岗位。

words.enDefinition: An arrangement that lists the most recent entry first

examples.en: I listed my campus jobs in reverse chronological order so the latest one appeared first.
examples.zh: 我按「时间倒序」列出校内工作经历，把最近的一份放在最前面。

examples.en: Our adviser showed us two education sections written in reverse chronological order.
examples.zh: 顾问给我们看了两份按「时间倒序」写的教育背景栏。

collocations: list jobs in reverse chronological order
arrange entries in reverse chronological order
present experience in reverse chronological order

words.enDefinition: A document organized around abilities rather than individual roles or dates

examples.en: My skills-based CV groups my tutoring and mentoring work under communication skills.
examples.zh: 我的「技能型简历」把辅导和指导经历都放在沟通技能一栏。

examples.en: The careers workshop compared a skills-based CV with one grouped by job title.
examples.zh: 就业指导讲座把「技能型简历」和按职位划分的简历作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A document featuring grouped skills and a dated employment history

examples.en: The combination resume opens with skill highlights and then lists my recent jobs.
examples.zh: 「混合型简历」先突出我的技能，再列出近期工作经历。

examples.en: The adviser showed me a combination resume with a short skills section above the dated roles.
examples.zh: 顾问给我看了一份「混合型简历」，上面简列技能，下面按日期列出各个职位。

words.enDefinition: An unfinished version of a document summarizing a job applicant's background

examples.en: My resume draft still had notes beside the entries I needed to check.
examples.zh: 我的「简历初稿」仍在待核实的条目旁留有备注。

examples.en: I shared a resume draft with my roommate before visiting the careers center.
examples.zh: 去就业中心前，我把「简历初稿」发给了室友。

words.enDefinition: An assessment of how clearly and effectively a document presents relevant experience

examples.en: I booked a resume review to ask whether my project descriptions made sense.
examples.zh: 我预约了「简历审阅」，想问一下我的项目描述是否容易理解。

examples.en: During the resume review, we found two different dates for the same job.
examples.zh: 在「简历审阅」时，我们发现同一份工作写了两个不同的日期。

words.enDefinition: The opening area displaying a job applicant's name and contact information

examples.en: I moved my phone number into the resume header beside my email address.
examples.zh: 我把电话号码移到了「简历页首」，放在邮箱地址旁边。

examples.en: My resume header took up too much room at the top of the page.
examples.zh: 我的「简历页首」占用了页面顶部太多空间。

collocations: include your email in the resume header

words.enDefinition: A short introduction highlighting relevant background and strengths for a job

examples.en: My professional summary connects my lab experience with the data work listed in the posting.
examples.zh: 我的「职业概况」把实验室经历和招聘信息中的数据工作联系起来。

examples.en: The adviser suggested shortening my professional summary to three lines under my name.
examples.zh: 顾问建议把我名字下方的「职业概况」缩短到三行。

words.enDefinition: A short statement describing the work an applicant seeks

examples.en: I rewrote my career objective to name the kind of internship I wanted.
examples.zh: 我重写了「求职目标」，明确写出我想找哪类实习。

examples.en: Her career objective helped the reader understand why she was applying to a museum.
examples.zh: 她的「求职目标」让读者明白她为什么要申请博物馆的职位。

words.enDefinition: A part of a CV listing degrees and academic qualifications

examples.en: I added my exchange semester to the education section below my current degree.
examples.zh: 我把交换学习的学期加进「教育背景栏」，放在目前就读的学位下面。

examples.en: The education section lists the university names before the degrees in this template.
examples.zh: 这个模板的「教育背景栏」把学校名称列在学位前面。

collocations: list degrees in the education section

words.enDefinition: The formal name of a degree awarded by an institution

examples.en: I checked my transcript for the exact degree title before updating my CV.
examples.zh: 更新简历之前，我查了成绩单上准确的「学位名称」。

examples.en: The degree title was too long for the line beside the university name.
examples.zh: 「学位名称」太长，无法和学校名称放在同一行。

words.enDefinition: Classes a student has taken that relate to particular work

examples.en: I kept statistics and database design under relevant coursework for the analyst position.
examples.zh: 申请分析师岗位时，我在「相关课程」里保留了统计学和数据库设计。

examples.en: She moved relevant coursework below her degree because it explained her technical background.
examples.zh: 她把「相关课程」移到学位下方，因为这些课能说明她的技术背景。

words.enDefinition: Formal recognition for strong academic work or achievement

examples.en: The adviser suggested moving my academic honors below the education entries to save space.
examples.zh: 为了节省空间，顾问建议把我的「学术荣誉」移到教育条目下方。

examples.en: The template had a single line under academic honors for prizes and distinctions.
examples.zh: 模板在「学术荣誉」下只留了一行来填写奖项和表彰。

words.enDefinition: The part of a document describing previous jobs or activities

examples.en: My experience section includes a campus job and two projects from class.
examples.zh: 我的「经历栏」包括一份校内工作和两个课程项目。

examples.en: I read the experience section aloud to hear where the descriptions sounded repetitive.
examples.zh: 我把「经历栏」念了一遍，听听哪些描述有些重复。

words.enDefinition: A record of jobs a person has held over time

examples.en: I checked my work history for the dates of two short summer jobs.
examples.zh: 我查了自己的「工作履历」，核对两份短期暑期工作的日期。

examples.en: The CV lists my work history separately from the jobs I did as a volunteer.
examples.zh: 简历把我的「工作履历」和志愿工作分开列出。

words.enDefinition: The dates showing when a person started and finished a job

examples.en: I used my old payslips to check the employment dates on my CV.
examples.zh: 我用旧工资单核对简历上的「任职起止日期」。

examples.en: The employment dates overlapped because I kept both campus jobs for a term.
examples.zh: 由于我有一学期同时做着两份校内工作，「任职起止日期」有重叠。

words.enDefinition: A period between jobs when someone was not employed

examples.en: I asked how to show an employment gap caused by full-time study.
examples.zh: 我问该怎么在简历上体现因全日制就读造成的「工作空档期」。

examples.en: The adviser helped me write a brief note explaining the employment gap.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我写了一条简短说明，解释这段「工作空档期」。

words.enDefinition: Unpaid work or activities carried out to help an organization or community

examples.en: I listed my volunteer experience at the community kitchen below my summer job.
examples.zh: 我在暑期工作下方列出了在社区厨房的「志愿服务经历」。

examples.en: Her volunteer experience shows she has already worked with children from different age groups.
examples.zh: 她的「志愿服务经历」说明她曾和不同年龄段的孩子打过交道。

words.enDefinition: Previous responsibilities involving guiding people or coordinating a group's work

examples.en: I used my leadership experience as club president to show how I handled disagreements.
examples.zh: 我用担任社团会长的「领导经历」说明自己如何处理分歧。

examples.en: The workshop helped me describe leadership experience from a project with four classmates.
examples.zh: 讲座帮助我描述了与四个同学合作完成项目时的「领导经历」。

words.enDefinition: Past involvement in systematic inquiry or the collection and analysis of evidence

examples.en: I added my research experience from the lab to the version for graduate applications.
examples.zh: 我把在实验室的「科研经历」加进了申请研究生用的版本。

examples.en: Her research experience includes interviews with students who commute to the campus.
examples.zh: 她的「科研经历」包括采访通勤到校的学生。

words.enDefinition: Prior work teaching, tutoring, or guiding people in their learning

examples.en: My teaching experience includes leading two tutorials for first-year biology students.
examples.zh: 我的「教学经历」包括为生物专业一年级学生带领两次辅导课。

examples.en: I moved teaching experience higher on the page for the summer tutoring position.
examples.zh: 申请暑期辅导岗位时，我把「教学经历」往页面上方移了。

words.enDefinition: A short list of projects chosen to illustrate relevant experience

examples.en: I listed two selected projects instead of describing every assignment from that course.
examples.zh: 我只列了两个「精选项目」，没有描述那门课的每项作业。

examples.en: The selected projects demonstrate different skills even though both came from the same placement.
examples.zh: 尽管这两个「精选项目」来自同一段实习经历，但它们体现了不同的技能。

words.enDefinition: Abilities that relate directly to the work being sought

examples.en: I put spreadsheet analysis under relevant skills for the finance internship.
examples.zh: 我申请财务实习时，把电子表格分析放在「相关技能」一栏。

examples.en: The workshop showed how to back up relevant skills with specific examples.
examples.zh: 讲座示范了如何用具体事例佐证「相关技能」。

words.enDefinition: The part of a CV that lists job-related technical abilities

examples.en: I moved the programming languages to a separate technical skills section below my projects.
examples.zh: 我把编程语言移到项目经历下方，单列「技术技能栏」。

examples.en: The technical skills section was hard to scan until I grouped the tools by purpose.
examples.zh: 原先「技术技能栏」不便浏览，我便按用途给工具分了组。

words.enDefinition: Abilities to speak, understand, read, or write in particular languages

examples.en: I listed my language skills just below my software experience on the CV.
examples.zh: 我把「语言能力」列在简历的软件使用经验下方。

examples.en: The museum role asked for language skills that I could demonstrate during an interview.
examples.zh: 博物馆的岗位要求申请人具备可在面试中展示的「语言能力」。

words.enDefinition: How well someone can use a language or skill

examples.en: I included a proficiency level next to each language on my CV.
examples.zh: 我在简历上的每种语言旁标出了「熟练程度」。

examples.en: The adviser asked how I had decided on my proficiency level for Excel.
examples.zh: 顾问问我如何判断自己的 Excel「熟练程度」。

words.enDefinition: A credential awarded for meeting standards in a field of work

examples.en: I listed the date of my professional certification next to its name.
examples.zh: 我把获得「专业认证」的日期写在认证名称旁边。

examples.en: One professional certification on my CV was due for renewal in December.
examples.zh: 我简历上的一项「专业认证」要在十二月续证。

words.enDefinition: A formal affiliation with an association in a field of work

examples.en: I listed my student chapter affiliation as a professional membership on the CV.
examples.zh: 我在简历的「专业协会会员资格」一栏列出了自己所在的学生分会。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether my professional membership was still active this year.
examples.zh: 顾问问我的「专业协会会员资格」今年是否仍然有效。

words.enDefinition: A record of articles, books, or other works someone has published

examples.en: I updated the list of publications after the journal released our article online.
examples.zh: 期刊在网上发表我们的文章后，我更新了「发表成果清单」。

examples.en: The sample academic CV puts its list of publications near the end of the document.
examples.zh: 那份学术履历样本把「发表成果清单」放在文件快结束的位置。

words.enDefinition: A published work evaluated by experts before it was accepted

examples.en: My first peer-reviewed publication came out after several months of revisions with my supervisor.
examples.zh: 我和导师修改了几个月，第一篇「同行评审出版物」终于发表了。

examples.en: The peer-reviewed publication was listed under articles rather than under conference presentations.
examples.zh: 这篇「同行评审出版物」列在文章栏，没列在会议报告栏。

collocations: a peer-reviewed publication in a journal

words.enDefinition: A talk or formal presentation given at an academic or professional conference

examples.en: I put the title of my conference presentation below the name of the meeting.
examples.zh: 我把「会议报告」的标题写在会议名称下方。

examples.en: The academic CV listed my conference presentation alongside a link to the abstract.
examples.zh: 学术履历列出了我的「会议报告」，还附上摘要链接。

words.enDefinition: A presentation that shares project results through a displayed poster

examples.en: My CV includes a poster presentation from the undergraduate research day in May.
examples.zh: 我的简历写了五月本科生科研日的一次「海报展示」。

examples.en: I mentioned my poster presentation because it explained the survey work I had done.
examples.zh: 我提到了「海报展示」，因为它说明了我之前做的调查工作。

words.enDefinition: A presentation given after the organizers specifically ask someone to speak

examples.en: I added an invited talk from our regional student conference to the academic CV.
examples.zh: 我把在区域学生会议上做的一次「受邀报告」加进了学术履历。

examples.en: My invited talk was listed separately from the poster I presented that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我的「受邀报告」和那天下午的海报展示是分开列的。

words.enDefinition: Participation in organized activities outside formal classes

examples.en: My extracurricular involvement included running the student radio station with two classmates.
examples.zh: 我的「课外活动参与经历」包括与两位同学共同运营学生电台。

examples.en: The adviser suggested describing what I did under extracurricular involvement in one sentence.
examples.zh: 顾问建议我在「课外活动参与经历」一栏用一句话讲清我做过什么。

words.enDefinition: A short explanation of what a project did and involved

examples.en: My project description names the tool we built and explains who used it.
examples.zh: 我的「项目描述」写出了我们制作的工具，并说明了使用者是谁。

examples.en: I removed two technical terms from the project description so readers could follow it.
examples.zh: 我从「项目描述」中删掉了两个专业术语，让读者更容易理解。

words.enDefinition: The work and activities included within the boundaries of a project

examples.en: I added one sentence explaining the project scope before listing my own tasks.
examples.zh: 列出个人任务前，我加了一句话说明「项目范围」。

examples.en: The reviewer asked me to describe the project scope in plain language.
examples.zh: 审阅者请我用通俗的话来描述「项目范围」。

words.enDefinition: A result or change produced by carrying out a project

examples.en: My first draft describes the task but leaves out the project outcome.
examples.zh: 我的初稿只写了任务，漏写了「项目成果」。

examples.en: The project outcome was a bilingual guide that new volunteers still use.
examples.zh: 「项目成果」是一份双语指南，新志愿者现在还在用。

words.enDefinition: An important result someone produced or contributed to in a role

examples.en: My key achievement was getting the library's new returns guide ready before orientation.
examples.zh: 我的「主要成就」是在迎新前完成了图书馆新的还书指南。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to add one key achievement to each experience entry.
examples.zh: 顾问让我为每一项经历加上一条「主要成就」。

words.enDefinition: A brief description of an action and the result it achieved

examples.en: I turned the duty into an accomplishment statement by describing what improved afterward.
examples.zh: 我写明了工作之后有哪些改进，把岗位职责写成了「成就陈述」。

examples.en: My accomplishment statement names the problem and shows how the team solved it.
examples.zh: 我的「成就陈述」交代了问题，并介绍了团队怎样解决它。

words.enDefinition: A verb that describes what a person did or accomplished

examples.en: I opened the bullet with an action verb so the reader knew what I did.
examples.zh: 我用「动作动词」开启这条要点，方便读者知道我做了什么。

examples.en: The adviser replaced a vague action verb with one describing my actual task.
examples.zh: 顾问把一个含糊的「动作动词」换成了能说明我实际做了什么的词。

words.enDefinition: Outcomes that can be expressed in numbers or other measurable terms

examples.en: The instructor asked for quantifiable results, so I added the attendance figures.
examples.zh: 老师要求给出「可量化成果」，于是我加上了出席人数。

examples.en: Our quantifiable results included shorter waiting times at the campus service desk.
examples.zh: 我们的「可量化成果」包括缩短了校园服务台的等候时间。

words.enDefinition: A change caused by an action that can be evaluated quantitatively

examples.en: I described the measurable impact of the guide with figures from our help desk.
examples.zh: 我用服务台的数据来描述那份指南产生的「可衡量的影响」。

examples.en: The reviewer asked whether my scheduling changes had a measurable impact on attendance.
examples.zh: 审阅者问我，调整日程是否对出席人数带来了「可衡量的影响」。

words.enDefinition: To express the results of your work using relevant numbers

examples.en: The workshop showed how to quantify your achievements using details from everyday jobs.
examples.zh: 讲座展示了怎样用日常工作的具体数据来「量化自己的成就」。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to explain how I would quantify your achievements for the mentoring project.
examples.zh: 顾问让我解释，在指导项目这一段经历里我会怎样「量化自己的成就」。

collocations: use figures to quantify your achievements

words.enDefinition: The amount of growth expressed relative to the original value

examples.en: My bullet included the percentage increase in attendance after we moved the meeting online.
examples.zh: 我在要点里写了会议改到线上后，出席人数的「百分比增幅」。

examples.en: I checked the percentage increase against our registration records before adding it to my CV.
examples.zh: 写进简历前，我拿报名记录核对了「百分比增幅」。

words.enDefinition: The amount of time a change prevents people from spending

examples.en: I estimated the time savings from replacing two forms with a single checklist.
examples.zh: 我估算了用一张清单取代两份表格后「节省的时间」。

examples.en: The project bullet uses time savings to explain why the new tool mattered.
examples.zh: 项目要点用「节省的时间」说明新工具的价值。

words.enDefinition: The amount of money saved by making a change

examples.en: My CV mentions the cost savings from switching to reusable materials at club events.
examples.zh: 我的简历提到社团活动改用可重复使用的材料后「节约的开支」。

examples.en: I gave a dollar figure for the cost savings in my project entry.
examples.zh: 我在项目经历里写明了「节约的开支」是多少美元。

words.enDefinition: The number of people who belong to a particular team

examples.en: The first bullet states the team size and explains what I coordinated.
examples.zh: 第一条要点写明了「团队人数」，并说明我协调了哪些工作。

examples.en: I left out the team size because the CV already mentioned all four roles.
examples.zh: 简历已提到全部四个分工，所以我省略了「团队人数」。

words.enDefinition: The part one person provided within work done by a group

examples.en: I added my individual contribution so the reader could distinguish my work from the team's.
examples.zh: 我补写了「个人贡献」，让读者能看出团队工作中哪部分是我做的。

examples.en: The reviewer asked me to explain my individual contribution to the final report.
examples.zh: 审阅者让我解释自己对最终报告的「个人贡献」。

words.enDefinition: The tasks and decisions a person is expected to handle

examples.en: I explained my scope of responsibility by listing the decisions I could make independently.
examples.zh: 我列出自己能独立作出的决定，说明「职责范围」。

examples.en: The scope of responsibility grew when I started organizing shifts for new volunteers.
examples.zh: 我开始给新志愿者排班后，「职责范围」扩大了。

words.enDefinition: To organize tasks and communication across a group

examples.en: Running the campus festival taught me how to coordinate a team during busy shifts.
examples.zh: 在筹办校园节庆活动时，我学会了怎样在忙碌的班次里「协调团队工作」。

examples.en: My CV describes how I helped coordinate a team during our research project.
examples.zh: 我的简历说明了我在科研项目中怎样帮助「协调团队工作」。

words.enDefinition: To guide a piece of work from planning to completion

examples.en: I volunteered to lead a project that mapped accessible routes across campus.
examples.zh: 我主动「牵头负责一个项目」，绘制校园无障碍路线图。

examples.en: The adviser asked what I did to lead a project with three classmates.
examples.zh: 顾问问我与三位同学一起「牵头负责项目」时做了哪些工作。

collocations: lead a project from start to finish
lead a project for a client

words.enDefinition: To plan, monitor, and control spending within available funds

examples.en: I learned to manage a budget while organizing weekly events for the society.
examples.zh: 我在为社团组织每周活动时学会了「管理预算」。

examples.en: My CV explains how I helped manage a budget for our final exhibition.
examples.zh: 我的简历说明了我如何协助为毕业展「管理预算」。

collocations: manage a budget for an event
manage a budget of several thousand dollars

words.enDefinition: To put a set of planned steps into regular practice

examples.en: I helped implement a process for checking returns at the student bookshop.
examples.zh: 我协助学生书店「推行流程」，规范退货检查。

examples.en: My supervisor asked how I would implement a process that new volunteers could follow.
examples.zh: 主管问我打算怎样「推行流程」，让新志愿者也能照着做。

collocations: implement a process across a team
implement a process for checking orders

words.enDefinition: To remove unnecessary steps so work moves more efficiently

examples.en: I helped streamline a workflow by combining the two forms we used every week.
examples.zh: 我把每周用的两份表格合并，协助「精简工作流程」。

examples.en: The first bullet explains how I helped streamline a workflow at the library desk.
examples.zh: 简历第一条要点解释了我如何帮助图书馆服务台「精简工作流程」。

words.enDefinition: To examine survey responses for patterns, differences, or useful findings

examples.en: I used spreadsheets to analyze survey data from three first-year student groups.
examples.zh: 我用电子表格「分析调查数据」，问卷来自三组大一学生。

examples.en: My CV mentions that I helped analyze survey data for a local charity.
examples.zh: 我的简历写道，我曾帮助当地一家慈善机构「分析调查数据」。

collocations: analyze survey data for a report

words.enDefinition: To bring information together and organize it into one document

examples.en: I helped compile a report using figures supplied by four departments on campus.
examples.zh: 我利用校内四个部门提供的数据协助「汇编报告」。

examples.en: My CV describes how I learned to compile a report from interviews and observation notes.
examples.zh: 我的简历写了我如何学会利用访谈内容和观察记录「汇编报告」。

collocations: compile a report from survey responses
compile a report for a supervisor

words.enDefinition: To put together documents for a short, focused information session

examples.en: I helped prepare briefing materials for the advisers who welcomed new international students.
examples.zh: 我协助为迎接新留学生的顾问「准备简报材料」。

examples.en: We worked in pairs to prepare briefing materials before the student committee met.
examples.zh: 学生委员会开会前，我们两人一组「准备简报材料」。

collocations: prepare briefing materials for a meeting

words.enDefinition: To explain what a study or investigation discovered to others

examples.en: I learned to present findings at a seminar attended by students from different departments.
examples.zh: 我在各院系学生参加的研讨会上学会了「汇报研究结果」。

examples.en: My CV describes how I helped present findings to the project's community partners.
examples.zh: 我的简历介绍了我如何协助向项目的社区合作伙伴「汇报研究结果」。

words.enDefinition: To teach new workers the skills or procedures their jobs require

examples.en: I helped train new staff on the returns system after my first semester.
examples.zh: 第一学期过后，我协助书店就退货系统「培训新员工」。

examples.en: My CV says I volunteered to train new staff at the campus café.
examples.zh: 我的简历写着，我曾主动帮校园咖啡馆「培训新员工」。

words.enDefinition: To offer ongoing support and guidance to less experienced students

examples.en: I volunteered to mentor junior students who had just joined our debate society.
examples.zh: 我志愿「指导低年级学生」，他们刚加入我们的辩论社。

examples.en: My CV explains why I chose to mentor junior students during the summer break.
examples.zh: 我的简历说明了我为什么选择在暑假「指导低年级学生」。

collocations: mentor junior students in a lab
mentor junior students through a program

words.enDefinition: To guide a practical session so participants can participate effectively

examples.en: I helped facilitate a workshop where first-year students practiced giving each other feedback.
examples.zh: 我协助「引导工作坊」，让大一学生练习互相提供反馈。

examples.en: The role gave me a chance to facilitate a workshop with another student adviser.
examples.zh: 这个岗位让我有机会与另一位学生顾问合作「引导工作坊」。

words.enDefinition: To manage the arrangements and practical work for an event

examples.en: I volunteered to run an event for students who stayed on campus during the break.
examples.zh: 我主动为假期留在校园的学生「组织活动」。

examples.en: My CV explains how I helped run an event that drew eighty students.
examples.zh: 我的简历介绍了我如何协助「组织活动」，吸引八十名学生参加。

words.enDefinition: To give a prepared talk or demonstration to an audience

examples.en: I was invited to deliver a presentation on accessible campus transport for our department.
examples.zh: 我应邀为院系就校园无障碍交通「作报告」。

examples.en: The project gave me a chance to deliver a presentation using two languages.
examples.zh: 这个项目给了我用两种语言「作报告」的机会。

collocations: deliver a presentation to a group
deliver a presentation on a topic
deliver a presentation at a meeting

words.enDefinition: To respond to questions and requests from people buying or using services

examples.en: I learned to handle customer inquiries about textbook returns in the campus shop.
examples.zh: 我在校内商店学会了如何「处理顾客咨询」，比如回答教材退货的问题。

examples.en: My first duty was to handle customer inquiries during the morning shift.
examples.zh: 我的第一项职责是早班时「处理顾客咨询」。

collocations: handle customer inquiries at a desk

words.enDefinition: To address customers' concerns and help reach an acceptable solution

examples.en: The part-time job taught me to resolve customer complaints calmly during busy shifts.
examples.zh: 在这份兼职中，我学会了在忙碌时冷静地「解决顾客投诉」。

examples.en: I worked with a supervisor to resolve customer complaints about incorrect library charges.
examples.zh: 我和主管一起「解决顾客投诉」，处理图书馆收费出错的问题。

words.enDefinition: To monitor how far work has moved toward completion

examples.en: I used a shared board to track progress across five student teams.
examples.zh: 我用共享看板为五个学生团队「跟踪进度」。

examples.en: My adviser asked how I helped track progress before the exhibition opened.
examples.zh: 顾问问我在展览开幕前怎样协助「跟踪进度」。

collocations: use a spreadsheet to track progress

words.enDefinition: To reach a stated level of performance or output

examples.en: The extra study sessions helped us meet a target for first-year attendance.
examples.zh: 增设学习时段后，大一学生的出席人数帮助我们「达成指标」。

examples.en: My CV explains how I helped the team meet a target for survey responses.
examples.zh: 我的简历说明了我怎样帮助团队在回收问卷这一项上「达成指标」。

collocations: meet a target ahead of schedule

words.enDefinition: To reduce how long people wait for an answer or service

examples.en: I helped improve response times by setting up separate queues for common requests.
examples.zh: 我为常见请求分别设立队列，帮助「缩短响应时间」。

examples.en: My CV describes one tool we used to improve response times at the help desk.
examples.zh: 我的简历介绍了我们在服务台用来「缩短响应时间」的一种工具。

collocations: improve response times at a help desk

words.enDefinition: To make a job or operation take less time to finish

examples.en: Our team combined two forms to reduce processing time for equipment requests.
examples.zh: 我们团队把两份设备申请表合二为一，从而「缩短处理时间」。

examples.en: I noted how we helped reduce processing time without removing any required checks.
examples.zh: 我写明了我们如何在保留必要检查的情况下帮助「缩短处理时间」。

words.enDefinition: To get more people to attend an event or activity

examples.en: I used shorter reminder emails to increase attendance at our weekly study groups.
examples.zh: 我用更简短的邮件提醒大家，帮助每周学习小组「提高出席人数」。

examples.en: The bullet explains how I helped increase attendance at two student events.
examples.zh: 简历要点说明了我如何帮助两场学生活动「提高出席人数」。

words.enDefinition: To make an early version of something for testing or demonstration

examples.en: I helped build a prototype of a tool for booking study rooms.
examples.zh: 我协助给自习室预订工具「制作原型」。

examples.en: Our research group used paper sketches to build a prototype before writing any code.
examples.zh: 写代码之前，我们科研小组用纸上草图「制作原型」。

words.enDefinition: To check whether a particular part of a product works properly

examples.en: I helped test a feature that let students renew books from their phones.
examples.zh: 我协助「测试一项功能」，让学生可以用手机续借图书。

examples.en: We asked five volunteers to test a feature before the campus app was released.
examples.zh: 校园应用发布前，我们请五位志愿者「测试一项功能」。

words.enDefinition: To write down the steps people follow to complete work

examples.en: I helped document procedures for the volunteers who opened the lab each morning.
examples.zh: 我协助为每天早上开实验室的志愿者「记录操作流程」。

examples.en: My CV states that I began to document procedures during my summer placement.
examples.zh: 我的简历写明，我在暑期实习时开始「记录操作流程」。

words.enDefinition: To write preliminary versions of documents for an organized program

examples.en: I helped draft program materials for an after-school reading program near campus.
examples.zh: 我协助为校园附近的课后阅读项目「起草项目材料」。

examples.en: We worked with teachers to draft program materials that students could use independently.
examples.zh: 我们与老师合作「起草项目材料」，让学生可以独立使用。

words.enDefinition: To create resources people use to learn how to perform work

examples.en: I helped design training materials for the students running our campus food bank.
examples.zh: 我协助为运营校园食物援助点的学生「设计培训材料」。

examples.en: The job gave me a chance to design training materials for people with different backgrounds.
examples.zh: 这份工作让我有机会为不同背景的人「设计培训材料」。

words.enDefinition: To arrange an event or campaign that raises money

examples.en: My CV describes how I helped organize a fundraiser for a local shelter.
examples.zh: 我的简历介绍了我怎样协助为当地一家收容机构「组织筹款活动」。

examples.en: We worked with two clubs to organize a fundraiser during the spring term.
examples.zh: 春季学期，我们和两个社团合作「组织筹款活动」。

words.enDefinition: To communicate with people who have an interest in a project

examples.en: I learned to liaise with stakeholders who used the community center every week.
examples.zh: 我学会了「与利益相关方沟通」，他们每周都使用社区中心。

examples.en: My adviser showed me how to describe my role when I had to liaise with stakeholders.
examples.zh: 顾问教我如何描述我在需要「与利益相关方沟通」时承担的职责。

collocations: liaise with stakeholders on a project

words.enDefinition: To work jointly with people who belong to different teams

examples.en: Our final project taught me to collaborate across teams without losing track of individual tasks.
examples.zh: 结课项目让我学会了「开展跨团队协作」，同时照看好各自任务。

examples.en: The placement gave me opportunities to collaborate across teams during two campus events.
examples.zh: 这次实习让我在两场校园活动中有机会「开展跨团队协作」。

collocations: collaborate across teams on a project

words.enDefinition: A grammatical form used for current actions, states, or habits

examples.en: I used the present tense for my current job at the campus library.
examples.zh: 我用「现在时」描述目前在校园图书馆的工作。

examples.en: We checked that the present tense appeared only in entries for ongoing roles.
examples.zh: 我们检查了「现在时」是否只出现在仍在任职的经历里。

collocations: keep verbs in the present tense

words.enDefinition: A grammatical form used to describe actions or states before now

examples.en: I rewrote the summer job entry in the past tense after leaving the role.
examples.zh: 暑期工作结束后，我把那段经历改用了「过去时」。

examples.en: The first bullet uses the past tense because I finished the project in May.
examples.zh: 第一条要点使用「过去时」，因为我在五月就完成了项目。

words.enDefinition: Clear writing that avoids unnecessary technical or complicated wording

examples.en: I rewrote my fieldwork entry in plain language for readers outside my department.
examples.zh: 我用「通俗表达」重写了田野调查经历，方便院系外的读者理解。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to describe the software in plain language.
examples.zh: 顾问让我用「通俗表达」描述那款软件。

words.enDefinition: A short title that identifies the content of a section

examples.en: I used the same font for each section heading on my CV.
examples.zh: 简历里的每个「栏目标题」我都用了同一种字体。

examples.en: The section heading made it easier to find my experience with community projects.
examples.zh: 「栏目标题」让人更容易找到我参与社区项目的经历。

words.enDefinition: The same visual rules applied throughout all parts of a document

examples.en: The reviewer checked for consistent formatting after I added a second page.
examples.zh: 我加了第二页后，审阅者检查了是否采用「一致的格式」。

examples.en: I used consistent formatting for locations and dates across the whole document.
examples.zh: 我让整份文件的地点和日期都采用「一致的格式」。

words.enDefinition: Empty areas that separate text or design elements on a page

examples.en: I added more white space between my education and experience sections.
examples.zh: 我在教育背景栏和经历栏之间增加了「留白」。

examples.en: The sample used white space to make each job entry easy to spot.
examples.zh: 样本通过「留白」让每段工作经历都容易找到。

collocations: make effective use of white space

words.enDefinition: The blank space between text and an edge of a page

examples.en: A wider page margin left room for notes during our resume workshop.
examples.zh: 更宽的「页边距」让我们在简历讲座上有地方记笔记。

examples.en: I checked the page margin because some letters looked too close to the edge.
examples.zh: 有些字母看起来离纸张边缘太近，我就检查了「页边距」。

words.enDefinition: The vertical distance between lines of text in a document

examples.en: I adjusted the line spacing so the bullets did not run together.
examples.zh: 我调整了「行距」，避免几条要点挤在一起。

examples.en: The line spacing differed between pages after I pasted in the new section.
examples.zh: 我粘贴新栏目后，两页的「行距」不一样了。

words.enDefinition: The measurement that determines how large text appears on a page

examples.en: I checked the font size after a friend struggled to read my printed CV.
examples.zh: 朋友看我的纸质简历有些吃力，我就检查了「字号」。

examples.en: The font size of my name was larger than the headings below it.
examples.zh: 我名字的「字号」比下方各栏目标题的更大。

words.enDefinition: The position of text relative to a margin, center, or other reference

examples.en: The text alignment changed when I pasted the job titles from another document.
examples.zh: 我从另一份文件粘贴职称后，「文本对齐」方式变了。

examples.en: We checked the text alignment so each employment date lined up on the right.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「文本对齐」方式，让每段任职日期都在右边对齐。

words.enDefinition: Space inserted at the beginning of a line or paragraph

examples.en: The indentation for the second bullet changed when I pasted the new text.
examples.zh: 我粘贴新文字时，第二条要点的「缩进」变了。

examples.en: I removed the extra indentation so the headings lined up properly.
examples.zh: 我去掉多余的「缩进」，让标题对齐。

words.enDefinition: The point where text ends one line and starts another

examples.en: An extra line break split my university name across two lines.
examples.zh: 多出来的一处「换行」把我学校的名称拆成了两行。

examples.en: I removed a line break so the dates stayed together on the page.
examples.zh: 我删掉一处「换行」，让日期留在同一行。

words.enDefinition: Automatic movement of text to the next line within a space

examples.en: The text wrapping pushed the second half of my job title onto another line.
examples.zh: 「文本自动换行」把我职位名称的后半部分挤到了下一行。

examples.en: I checked the text wrapping after making the right-hand column slightly narrower.
examples.zh: 我把右栏调窄了一点，然后检查了「文本自动换行」情况。

words.enDefinition: A marker forcing content to begin on a new page

examples.en: An unexpected page break left my project title at the bottom of the first page.
examples.zh: 一个没留意的「分页符」把我的项目标题留在了第一页底部。

examples.en: I moved the page break to keep the entire project entry together.
examples.zh: 我移动了「分页符」，让整条项目经历留在同一页。

words.enDefinition: A view showing how a document will look when printed

examples.en: I opened print preview and noticed that my email address had been cut off.
examples.zh: 我打开「打印预览」，发现自己的邮箱地址没显示完整。

examples.en: The print preview showed an extra page that was not visible in the editor.
examples.zh: 「打印预览」里多了一页，在编辑界面中看不到。

words.enDefinition: A copy of a document saved in Portable Document Format

examples.en: The PDF version kept the layout I had checked on my laptop.
examples.zh: 「PDF版」保留了我在笔记本电脑上检查过的版式。

examples.en: I opened the PDF version to check every heading and email link.
examples.zh: 我打开「PDF版」，检查每个栏目标题和邮箱链接。

words.enDefinition: A copy of a document whose content can still be changed

examples.en: I kept an editable version so I could update the dates next semester.
examples.zh: 我保留了「可编辑版本」，这样下学期可以更新日期。

examples.en: My friend asked for the editable version so she could add comments directly.
examples.zh: 朋友要了「可编辑版本」，好直接加批注。

words.enDefinition: A review that identifies possible spelling errors in text

examples.en: I ran a spell check before trying to fit everything onto one page.
examples.zh: 我试着把内容压缩到一页之前，先运行了「拼写检查」。

examples.en: The spell check flagged an organization name that I had spelled correctly.
examples.zh: 「拼写检查」标出了一个我其实拼对了的机构名称。

words.enDefinition: The ease with which people can read and understand text

examples.en: We compared the readability of two versions with different section headings.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两份栏目标题不同的简历的「易读性」。

examples.en: The adviser said longer bullets were hurting the readability of my CV.
examples.zh: 顾问说简历要点写得太长，影响了「易读性」。

words.enDefinition: To check your job document for errors before sharing it

examples.en: The careers adviser offered to help me proofread your resume before the campus fair.
examples.zh: 校园招聘会前，职业顾问主动提出帮我「校对简历」。

examples.en: Our handout explains how to proofread your resume when the layout has changed.
examples.zh: 讲义说明了调整版式之后该怎么「校对简历」。

collocations: ask someone to proofread your resume
take time to proofread your resume

words.enDefinition: Software that helps employers organize and manage job applications

examples.en: Our adviser explained why an applicant tracking system might read a CV differently from a person.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「招聘申请管理系统」读取简历的方式为什么可能和人不一样。

examples.en: The workshop showed how an applicant tracking system displays names and education details.
examples.zh: 讲座展示了「招聘申请管理系统」如何显示姓名和教育背景。

collocations: an applicant tracking system parses resumes
software for an applicant tracking system

words.enDefinition: Automated extraction of details from a job applicant's document

examples.en: The test showed that resume parsing placed my department in the wrong field.
examples.zh: 测试显示，「简历信息解析」把我的院系放进了错误的栏目。

examples.en: Our workshop compared resume parsing results from two versions of the same file.
examples.zh: 讲座上，我们比较了同一文件两个版本的「简历信息解析」结果。

words.enDefinition: Text that software can extract and interpret from a file

examples.en: The test file contained machine-readable text that I could copy into another document.
examples.zh: 测试文件含有「机器可读文本」，我可以把这些字复制到另一份文档中。

examples.en: The adviser showed how to check for machine-readable text in the exported file.
examples.zh: 顾问演示了怎么检查导出的文件中是否有「机器可读文本」。

collocations: convert an image to machine-readable text

words.enDefinition: A design placing the main content in one vertical column

examples.en: I switched to a single-column layout because the shorter lines broke my project titles.
examples.zh: 我换成了「单栏版式」，因为之前每行太短，把项目名称断开了。

examples.en: A single-column layout made it easier to follow my education and experience in order.
examples.zh: 「单栏版式」让人更容易按顺序阅读我的教育背景和经历。

words.enDefinition: Terms that signal skills, tools, or experience relevant to a role

examples.en: I chose resume keywords that reflected both the posting and my actual experience.
examples.zh: 我选择的「简历关键词」既呼应了招聘信息，也符合我的实际经历。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether the resume keywords matched the tools I had used.
examples.zh: 顾问问这些「简历关键词」是否与我实际使用过的工具相符。

words.enDefinition: Repeating many search terms unnaturally to influence automated matching

examples.en: The class discussed keyword stuffing after reading a CV that repeated the same skills.
examples.zh: 全班看了一份反复列出相同技能的简历后，讨论了「关键词堆砌」。

examples.en: We rewrote the example to remove keyword stuffing and restore some context.
examples.zh: 我们改写了这个例子，删掉「关键词堆砌」的内容，补回了一点上下文。

words.enDefinition: An arrangement that lets readers locate important details quickly

examples.en: The adviser suggested a scannable layout so recruiters could find my project work quickly.
examples.zh: 顾问建议用「便于扫读的版式」，方便招聘人员快速找到我的项目经历。

examples.en: The scannable layout put headings in bold and left space between sections.
examples.zh: 「便于扫读的版式」把栏目标题加粗，并在栏目之间留出空白。

words.enDefinition: A list or record of changes to a document over time

examples.en: I used the version history to recover a bullet I had deleted.
examples.zh: 我用「版本记录」找回了自己删掉的一条要点。

examples.en: The version history helped me confirm which document the adviser had reviewed.
examples.zh: 「版本记录」帮我确认顾问审阅的是哪一份文档。

collocations: restore a file from version history

words.enDefinition: A document formatted so application software can extract its information

examples.en: The adviser showed me an ATS-friendly resume with simple headings and clean text.
examples.zh: 顾问给我看了一份「适合系统解析的简历」，标题简洁，文字清晰。

examples.en: I saved an ATS-friendly resume alongside the more colorful version for the fair.
examples.zh: 除了招聘会上用的彩色版，我还保存了「适合系统解析的简历」。

words.enDefinition: A design that places main content in two vertical columns

examples.en: The two-column layout put my skills and work history side by side.
examples.zh: 「双栏版式」把我的技能和工作履历并排列出。

examples.en: I switched away from the two-column layout after two titles wrapped awkwardly.
examples.zh: 两个标题换行后看起来不顺眼，所以我换掉了「双栏版式」。

words.enDefinition: Individual records describing studies or qualifications within an education section

examples.en: I corrected the education entries after finding the dates of my exchange semester.
examples.zh: 查到交换学期的日期后，我更正了「教育经历条目」。

examples.en: The education entries appeared above my recent jobs in the new version.
examples.zh: 新版简历把「教育经历条目」放在近期工作经历上方。

words.enDefinition: To explain the tasks and decisions assigned to you

examples.en: The template leaves room to describe your responsibilities below each job title.
examples.zh: 模板在每个职位名称下方留了空，让你「描述自己的职责」。

examples.en: My adviser suggested using one example to describe your responsibilities at the library.
examples.zh: 顾问建议我用一个例子「描述自己在图书馆的职责」。

collocations: describe your responsibilities in a role

words.enDefinition: The amount of work handled within a given period

examples.en: The adviser asked whether I had figures for the office's workload volume.
examples.zh: 顾问问我是否有关于办公室「处理的工作量」的数据。

examples.en: The workload volume made it easier to understand the scale of my role.
examples.zh: 「处理的工作量」的数据让人更容易理解我的工作规模。

words.enDefinition: To present dates in the same form throughout a document

examples.en: The reviewer reminded me to use consistent dates across all three experience entries.
examples.zh: 审阅者提醒我在三条经历里「统一日期格式」。

examples.en: The sample shows how to use consistent dates when listing ongoing and past roles.
examples.zh: 样本示范了同时列出在职和已结束的经历时怎样「统一日期格式」。

words.enDefinition: A formal role in teaching, research, or academic administration

examples.en: The sample CV listed each academic appointment with the institution and dates.
examples.zh: 简历样本为每个「学术职位」都列了机构和任职日期。

examples.en: I asked why the academic appointment appeared separately from the author's degrees.
examples.zh: 我问为什么「学术职位」和作者的学位是分开列的。

collocations: an academic appointment at a university

words.enDefinition: Topics or questions that someone is interested in investigating

examples.en: I listed my research interests near the top of the academic CV.
examples.zh: 我在学术履历靠近开头的地方列出了「研究兴趣」。

examples.en: My supervisor asked whether my research interests had changed since the fieldwork.
examples.zh: 导师问这次田野调查后我的「研究兴趣」是否变了。

words.enDefinition: The dates marking when someone started and finished attending an institution

examples.en: I checked the dates of attendance in the registrar's letter before editing my CV.
examples.zh: 编辑简历前，我核对了教务处信里的「就读起止日期」。

examples.en: The template asks for dates of attendance beside the name of each university.
examples.zh: 模板要求把「就读起止日期」写在每所大学名称旁边。

words.enDefinition: A short account of the work someone does in a role

examples.en: My role description explains what I did at the library during evening shifts.
examples.zh: 我的「岗位职责描述」说明了我在图书馆上晚班时做了什么。

examples.en: The adviser shortened the role description to make room for one achievement.
examples.zh: 顾问缩短了「岗位职责描述」，以腾出位置写一项成果。

words.enDefinition: The sequence in which parts of a document appear

examples.en: I changed the section order to put lab projects before campus jobs.
examples.zh: 我调整了「栏目顺序」，把实验室项目放在校内工作前面。

examples.en: The adviser asked why I had used a different section order this time.
examples.zh: 顾问问我为什么这次用了不同的「栏目顺序」。

words.enDefinition: The dates showing when a project started and ended

examples.en: I found the project dates in our final report before updating my CV.
examples.zh: 更新简历前，我在最终报告里找到了「项目起止日期」。

examples.en: The project dates helped the reader see which projects I had completed recently.
examples.zh: 「项目起止日期」帮助读者看出哪些项目是我近期完成的。

words.enDefinition: A formal role in which someone is accountable for particular work

examples.en: My first position of responsibility was coordinating equipment for the campus radio station.
examples.zh: 我第一次「承担管理职责的职务」时，负责协调校广播站的设备。

examples.en: The sample CV gave one position of responsibility in a student society as an example.
examples.zh: 简历样本举了在学生社团「承担管理职责的职务」作为例子。

collocations: take on a position of responsibility

words.enDefinition: A visual line that separates parts of a document

examples.en: I added a section divider between the education and experience sections.
examples.zh: 我在教育背景栏和经历栏之间加了一条「栏目分隔线」。

examples.en: The section divider was hard to see on the printed copy of my CV.
examples.zh: 我的纸质简历上，「栏目分隔线」不太看得清。
